statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail stays at the top of the low band: a fresh record high printed after the cash open, yet a 200-point futures retracement has already traded, implied volatility is flat near 15.5, and yields and crude are both easing.
recommendation: Tail holds just below the watch threshold. The opening auction extended to a new record, which is a genuine amplifier, but the 31,339.00 futures low shows retracements are still printing and the VIX range of 15.28-15.54 shows no volatility expansion. The narrow evidence-based danger window is the 19:00Z-20:00Z power hour, where a record close pinned on the session extreme would be the structure most likely to deny mean reversion. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold 31,561.50 after setting a fresh 31,583.75 record high; a 200-point retracement keeps Tail at 19 in the low band with Stress steady at 46.
body: NQ December futures trade at 31,561.50, up 243.75 or 0.78%, roughly 22 points below the 31,583.75 session and 52-week high set after the 13:30Z cash open, and above the prior 31,317.75 close. Cash NDX is at 31,282.41, up 205.97 or 0.66%, about 46 points under its own new 31,328.56 record and some 74 points above the 31,208.20 session low, so the opening range has traded two ways rather than pinning the extreme. The 31,339.00 futures low confirms a genuine 200-point retracement earlier in the session. Volatility is not expanding: the VIX is 15.49, down 0.03, inside a narrow 15.28-15.54 range. Cross-assets are aligned risk-on but in a benign direction for mean reversion, with the 10-year Treasury yield easing to 5.286% from 5.313% and the 2-year to 4.804% from 4.833%, while WTI falls 1.60% to 88.00 and Brent 1.93% to 98.38 as the G7 strategic release of up to 100 million barrels and recovering Middle Eastern exports ease supply concerns. Yields nevertheless remain near multi-year highs and the Hormuz reopening conditions are unresolved, with Houthi strikes claimed on Saudi airports and an Aramco refinery, which keeps Stress in the elevated band at 46. The August goods and services deficit widened to 105.6 billion dollars from a revised 92.8 billion, the widest since March 2025 and wider than the roughly 102 billion expected, and the index absorbed it without disorderly repricing. RCM/TIPP Economic Optimism printed 46.8 at 14:00Z. Tail is set at 19 rather than in the watch band because the two Tail amplifiers present, opening-auction continuation and a hold near the extreme, are offset by printed retracements, a 120-point opening range and decaying implied volatility. The September CPI release is confirmed for 14 October against the Bureau of Labor Statistics schedule, so no first-tier inflation print falls inside this forecast window, and the September FOMC minutes at 18:00Z on 7 October sit just beyond its far edge.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail entered the window at 17 during Monday's New York afternoon, eased to 9 by 16:00Z, then rebuilt through the U.S. close to a 20 peak at 19:00Z as the index pushed to a record close, the only watch-band reading of the window. It decayed overnight into an 8-12 band through the Asian and European sessions, with Stress holding 45-47, before climbing back to 13-16 from 10:00Z as European trade turned constructive and the index approached Tuesday's cash open. Confidence stayed in the high band throughout at 86-88.
outlookSummary: The orderly path is expected to persist, with 23 of 24 forecast hours below the watch threshold, so the mapped policy state remains EA_ON across almost the whole window. Conditional Tail is held at 17-19 through the New York afternoon and reaches the watch band at 20 only in the 19:00Z power hour, the narrow evidence-based danger window, where a record close pinned on the session extreme is the structure that would most plausibly deny mean reversion. It then decays to 10-16 across the post-close, Asian and early European hours as liquidity thins and continuation mechanics lapse, before rebuilding to 13-18 into Wednesday's 13:30Z cash open. Stress tracks 41-48 in the moderate-to-elevated bands on high absolute yields and unresolved Middle East supply risk, and Confidence decays from 88 to 79 with forecast distance. All forecast structure beyond the current hour is conditional rather than observed.
